gui.busy: A verification is running. Wait for it to finish or cancel it first.
ui.quit_running: A verification is still running. Cancel it and quit? The temporary restore is cleaned up first.
ui.wv2_missing: The Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime is required but is not installed.
ui.wv2_help: Install the WebView2 Runtime from https://developer.microsoft.com/microsoft-edge/webview2/ and start BackupHarbor again. BackupHarbor does not download it for you. The command-line tool bharbor.exe works without it.
ui.demo_on_note: Sample data only. No repository is accessed.
ui.demo_banner_text: Everything shown here is sample data, clearly separate from your real results. No repository is accessed and nothing is restored.
ui.demo_banner_run: This is a simulated run with sample data. No repository is accessed and the result is not stored.
ui.demo_run_text: Start a simulated verification to see how progress and results look. Nothing real is touched.
ui.demo_targets_note: Demo mode is on. Target changes affect your real configuration.
ui.demo_reports_note: These are sample reports. Your real report history is not shown while demo mode is on.
ui.demo_schedule_note: Demo mode is on. The scheduled task cannot be changed.
ui.try_demo_text: See sample results without touching any backup.
ui.dashboard_sub: The latest verification result of every backup target.
ui.no_reports_yet: No verification has been recorded yet.
ui.no_targets_text: Add the restic repository you want to verify. BackupHarbor restores a snapshot into a private work area and checks it.
ui.setup_text: Three things are needed before the first verification.
ui.setup_restic_help: BackupHarbor normally ships its own restic.exe next to the application; if it is missing, reinstall BackupHarbor or pick another restic.exe here (https://restic.net).
ui.setup_config_missing: No configuration file exists yet. It will be created at
ui.setup_target_text: Point BackupHarbor at a restic repository and tell it where the password is kept.
ui.verify_sub: Restore real snapshots into a private work area and check them.
ui.verify_explain: A verification restores the selected snapshot into a temporary work area owned by BackupHarbor, checks the files you defined, and deletes the work area afterwards. Your backup repository is only read. Duration and disk use depend on the size of the snapshot.
ui.cancelling: Cancelling. The work area is cleaned up first.
ui.save_error: The result could not be saved:
ui.scope_check_subset: Integrity check: structure plus sample of data (%s)
ui.delete_target_text: Delete the target '%s'? Its stored password is removed too. Your backup repository is not touched.
ui.pw_stored: Password stored in Windows Credential Manager
ui.pw_keep: Leave empty to keep the stored password
ui.t_name_hint: Letters, digits, dot, dash and underscore.
ui.t_repo_hint: A local folder or any restic repository address (sftp:, s3:, rest:, ...).
ui.t_pw_hint: Stored encrypted for your Windows account in Windows Credential Manager. It is never written to the configuration file, logs or reports.
ui.t_pw_credname: Credential name (optional, defaults to the target name)
ui.t_pw_env_hint: The variable must be set for the user account that runs BackupHarbor, including scheduled runs. Other programs of the same user can read environment variables.
ui.t_pw_file_hint: Protect the file with NTFS permissions. Anyone who can read it can open the repository.
ui.t_snap_tags_hint: Comma separated. A snapshot must carry all of them.
ui.rd_cost_none: Fast. Checks the repository structure, indexes and metadata. It does not read the stored data blocks, so a damaged data block can go unnoticed.
ui.rd_cost_subset: Reads and verifies part of the stored data (for example 5%). Cost grows with the sample size and the speed of the storage.
ui.rd_cost_all: Reads and verifies every stored data block. This is the only integrity check that proves the data itself is intact, but it downloads or reads the whole repository and can take hours on large or remote repositories.
ui.t_restore_enable: Restore the snapshot into a private work area
ui.t_verify: Read restored files back and compare them with the repository
ui.t_verify_hint: Recommended. Costs extra time but proves that what was written to disk matches what the backup contains.
ui.t_timeout_hint: For example 30m or 4h. Empty uses the global limit.
ui.t_include_hint: One restic include pattern per line. Empty restores the whole snapshot. Only the restored part is tested.
ui.t_lock_hint: Off by default so the repository is never written to. Turn on if a concurrent prune could otherwise disturb the check.
ui.t_rules_hint: Check that restored files are actually usable. Paths are relative to the restore root, which contains the drive letter as a folder, so start with **/ (for example **/accounts.sqlite). Opening or parsing a file does not prove the application using it will work.
ui.test_note: This only checks restic, the password, access to the repository and the snapshot selection. No data is restored.
ui.reports_sub: History of verification runs, shared with the command line.
ui.schedule_sub: Run verifications automatically with Windows Task Scheduler.
ui.schedule_note: The task runs bharbor.exe as your Windows user and only while you are signed in. It uses the same configuration and report history as this application.
ui.remove_task_text: Remove the BackupHarbor scheduled task? Automatic verification stops.
ui.task_failed: The scheduled task could not be changed:
ui.cli_missing: bharbor.exe was not found next to the application (%s). The scheduled task needs it.
ui.temp_dir_hint: Restored data is written here temporarily and deleted afterwards. Use a folder with enough free space; BackupHarbor only ever deletes folders it created itself.
ui.concurrency_hint: How many targets are verified at the same time.
ui.extra_formats_hint: The JSON record is always saved.
ui.privacy_note: BackupHarbor sends no telemetry, makes no network requests of its own and never updates itself. Network access happens only through restic when your repository is remote.
ui.config_problem: The configuration file cannot be read
ui.config_problem_help: Fix the file in a text editor or move it away, then retry. BackupHarbor will not overwrite it.
